name: The South Road
description: The caravan creaks north through dry hills. Thornwick's towers show on the horizon.

name: Thornwick
description: A walled market town where three roads meet. Warehouses crowd the gate square, and the Dawn Hall's bell carries over the roofs.

name: Abandoned Camp
description: A ring of cold firepits beside the east track. Nobody has slept here for days.

name: Bandit Ridge
description: A rocky shelf over the track, good for watching travellers.

name: The Impossible Fork
description: The track splits. One branch runs on as it always has. The other is paved, and should not be here.

name: The Stone Ring
description: The paved branch ends on a bare hilltop, at a low ring of fitted stones.
